answer: Belfius Bank's 2025 minimum consolidated CET1 requirement before P2G is 10.88% = Pillar 1 4.50% + P2R 1.15% + CCB 2.50% + O-SII 1.50% + CCyB 1.02% + sectoral systemic risk buffer 0.21%. The Pillar 2 add-on counted is 1.15%, versus a total P2R of 2.02% (reviewed down from the 2.24% initially set in Dec 2024; 2.16% in 2024). The difference arises because P2R can be split across capital types: only 56.25% of the P2R must be held as CET1 (applied to the 'general' P2R of 2.00%, i.e. 1.125%), plus a prudential add-on for non-performing exposures of 2 bps, also in CET1 (about 1.145%, shown as 1.15%); the rest (about 0.87%) may be met with AT1/Tier 2. The lower NPE add-on is covered by a larger additional CET1 deduction for NPE insufficient loss coverage. Adding P2G of 1.00% gives 11.88%.

evidence.text: a Pillar 2 Requirement (P2R) of 1.15% (after split of 2.02% P2R)
56.25% CET 1 capital for the “general” P2R of 2.00% and includes a prudential add-on for non-performing exposures of 2 bps to be held in the form of CET 1 capital
minimum CET 1 capital ratio for 2025 of 10.88% (before Pillar 2 Guidance)

notes: Sum checks to 10.88%. Gap 2.02-1.15=0.87pp is my arithmetic; the document explains the split via 56.25% rule and NPE add-on, not the 0.87 figure explicitly. Figures in %.
